75346: Clear [Special Portal 2](#loc=75316) in Symphony of Sorcery as Riku.
75373:
If you've been doing well with the Dive boss battles, you'll have no problem with Chernabog. On the other hand, if the Dive battles are frustrated you—Chernabog might be a struggle.

The fight begins with Chernabog in the distance, and Riku will automatically be set to fly forwards. Much like Dive sequences, avoid projectiles and obstacles sent along the path Riku is flying on. Get close enough to land three hits on Chernabog to end the boss fight. Each of Riku's hits will increase make Chernabog's attacks more frenetic, but nothing too difficult.
